title: Developers can track app earnings
summary:
Developers got an earnings view, media uploads grew to 50 MB, and the Pollen rules became easier to find and understand.

Enter gained an Earnings section for developers with publishable BYOP app keys. It shows markup earnings, active users, and top apps, with chart filters and CSV export. An authenticated earnings endpoint provides chart data and app-level rollups.

The media upload limit increased from 10 MB to 50 MB. The same PR documented the existing 30-day retention period for generated content and uploads; the cache duration did not change.

The Terms, Refunds policy, and Privacy Policy now cover Pollen wallets, app authorization, and developer earnings. Wallets expire after 12 months of account inactivity starting June 1, 2026; for existing balances, the inactivity clock starts on that date.
